# Europe second global pass — 28 October 2026

Two missing commercial sites qualify against the selected hundredthird base (847 sites / 915 projects). This packet contains proposed additions only; the parent reviews and integrates. No tracked source, definition, dataset, configuration or documentation files were changed by this agent.

## NINET Niš — operational, 30 July 2026

The operator-hosted ZIP contains `BGRS0500152-TD01-PP2/A/a5e_contract_notice.docx`. Its body explicitly describes an operating Niš data centre providing commercial hosting, cloud/VPS and IT services. The same notice labels the data-centre place of performance as Bulevar Nemanjića 25, TC Zona 3, premises K6. Its publication date is explicitly Thursday 30 July 2026, exactly 90 days before 28 October; publication is the contemporaneous operating observation here, not a later file modification.

The exact DOCX member bytes and complete fetched ZIP have separate recorded SHA-256 hashes. The source hash covers the complete ZIP response, with the member path recorded for reproducibility. The locally extracted `.txt` is a convenience extraction from DOCX XML, not the source record or a replacement capture. The government's indexed 30 July tender page corroborates publication, but its raw urllib capture failed TLS certificate validation; that failed capture is not used as a source. No TLS verification was disabled.

OSM way 340266480 is the named Zona 3 building and independently carries house number 25 and the matching Bulevar Nemanjića street. A direct Nominatim lookup of that exact way returns the selected point, longitude 21.9152273 and latitude 43.3217041. The original locally calculated centroid was replaced during peer review, so the final locator is explicitly source-returned. This is an occupied part of a mixed-use building: the point locates the host property, not premises K6 internally; the polygon does not claim that the whole mall is a data centre. Uncertainty is unknown.

Successor review: the operator timeline reports a 7 August site visit and 23 September equipment procurement result. Lot 1 (racks/UPS) was awarded; Lot 2 (virtualization) was cancelled. These events do not refresh operation to September or prove installation/commissioning. The two downloaded supporting PDFs produced decompression errors in pdftotext, so their purported content is not relied upon; the captured HTML timeline and readable original DOCX suffice.

Webglobe's historical January 2022 transaction names NiNet web-hosting business in its portfolio. The current Webglobe Serbia contact address differs. Neither is evidence of physical relocation or closure of the explicitly identified 2026 NiNet data centre. The 2026 notice names Ninet Company d.o.o., registration 17499114, as its operating entity. Accordingly the packet assigns only that evidenced operator role, leaves ownership unassigned and admits no separate Webglobe site. This corporate-history limitation is retained in the public factual summaries.

## ZONER DC Brno, Nové sady — operational, 8 October 2026

The CZECHIA.COM article visibly dated 8 October states that the company's services run in its own ZONER DC in Brno. This is current named-facility operation, not a generic copyright or last-modified date. The article's later news links do not alter its date.

ZonerCloud's technical page identifies its primary DC as in the ZONER administrative building and names the own facility as ZONER DC, Brno, Nové sady. The operator contacts give Nové sady 583/18. Official RÚIAN address feature 19108877 returns exactly Nové sady 583/18, building 18955126, and geometry in EPSG:4326. This is a host-building address marker, not the internal equipment room or building boundary. Uncertainty is unknown. The source-service metadata names ČÚZK copyright; no assumed open-data redistribution licence is asserted for the raw response.

All five current-base tables, 73 published holds files and other available local holds were scanned. Exact bounded aliases and address identifiers produce no matches for either proposed site.
